title: 第25章 疯狂融卡
novel_title: 穿越源卡大陆，我自带融合卡牌
content_zh:
将风铃猫的伤爪用干净纱布仔细缠好，林奇抬头看向林峰。

    “爹，把你的副卡都给我。”

    林峰没有半分犹豫，自从林奇拿出那些器具卡，他就彻底信了儿子的本事。

    只见他抬手一挥，四道流光从他指尖飘出，落在桌上化作四张卡牌，两张泛着淡绿光晕，两张则是普通的白色，正是他契约的全部副卡。

    “我上楼给你炼制新副卡，你帮风铃弄点肉吃。”

    林奇将四张卡牌收好，起身时揉了揉风铃猫的下巴，小家伙舒服地眯起眼睛，发出满足的呼噜声。

    “放心吧，我会照顾好这小家伙的。”

    “喵~”风铃猫抬头看了林奇一眼，尾巴轻轻扫了扫他的裤腿，像是在给他加油。

    ......

    林奇快步上楼，反手关紧房门。

    将四张卡牌一一摆在桌子上。

    他的目光先是落在那张绿色技能卡迎风一刀斩上。

    这张卡是林峰当年在佣兵团时，从一伙悍匪手里拼死夺来的，不仅是二星品质，还附带独特的斩风效果，就算是万卡阁的货架上，也找不出第二张一模一样的。

    “能不能成，就看你的了。”

    林奇深吸一口气，从木盒里取出五张白色技能卡，斩击。

    这是最基础的刀剑类技能卡，但售价却已经达到了一千卡恩一张，堪比一张白色品质中最好御兽卡的价格。

    技能卡能直接增幅本命卡的威力，一直是供不应求的稀缺货，而且越契合本命卡，发挥的效果越强，价格也高的离谱。

    “融合！”

    一道黑色漩涡瞬间在桌面中央成型。

    五张白卡被漩涡缓缓吞噬，光芒流转间，一张泛着绿色光晕的新卡牌浮了出来。

    技能卡，强斩

    星级：二级

    品质：绿色

    卡介：挥砍出一道强有力的斩击，斩击效果随距离递减。

    评价：是器具类御卡师不错的技能搭配。

    没有停顿，他又取出五张一星技能卡“剑锋”投入漩涡。

    这次漩涡转动得更快，片刻后，第二张绿卡悄然成型。

    技能卡，锋芒

    星级：二级

    品质：绿色
content_en:
After carefully wrapping the wind chime cat's injured claw with clean gauze, Lin Qi raised his head and looked at Lin Feng.

    "Dad, give me all your secondary cards."

    Lin Feng didn't hesitate for a moment. Ever since Lin Qi took out those equipment cards, he completely believed in his son's ability.

    He raised his hand and waved, and four streams of light floated out from his fingertips, falling on the table and turning into four cards, two with a light green halo, and two with ordinary white, which were all the secondary cards of his contract.

    "I'll go upstairs and refine a new secondary card for you, and you can help Feng Chime get some meat to eat."

    Lynch put away the four cards and rubbed the Chime Cat's chin when he stood up. The little guy narrowed his eyes in comfort and purred with satisfaction.

    "Don't worry, I will take good care of this little guy."

    "Meow~" The wind chime cat raised his head and glanced at Lin Qi, then lightly swept his trouser legs with his tail, as if to cheer him up.

    ...

    Lin Qi quickly went upstairs and closed the door tightly with his backhand.

    Place the four cards on the table one by one.

    His eyes first fell on the green skill card, Windward Slash.

    This card was snatched by Lin Feng from a group of gangsters when he was in the mercenary group. Not only was it of two-star quality, but it also had a unique wind-cutting effect. Even on the shelves of Wanka Pavilion, there was no second identical card.

    "Whether you can make it or not is up to you."

    Lynch took a deep breath, took out five white skill cards from the wooden box, and slashed.

    This is the most basic sword skill card, but its price has reached one thousand karen, which is comparable to the price of the best beast control card in white quality.

    Skill cards can directly increase the power of life cards, and have always been in short supply. The more they match the life cards, the stronger the effect, and the price is ridiculously high.

    "Fusion!"

    A black vortex instantly formed in the center of the table.

    The five white cards were slowly swallowed by the vortex. As the light circulated, a new card with a green halo emerged.

    Skill card, strong cut

    Star rating: Level 2

    Quality: green

    Kajie: slashes with a powerful slash, the effect of the slash decreases with distance.

    Evaluation: It is a good skill combination for equipment card masters.

    Without pausing, he took out five more one-star skill cards "Jianfeng" and threw them into the whirlpool.

    This time the vortex rotated faster, and after a moment, the second green card quietly took shape.

    Skill card, edge

    Star rating: Level 2

    Quality: green
